newsitem.title: USA: Alcatel buys 10 pct stake in SSE.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel buys 10 pct stake in SSE.

text.p: SSE Telecom Inc said on Friday Alcatel Telspace SA, a unit of Alcatel Alsthom, has purchased 625,000 shares of SSE common stock for $7,826,500, or an average price of $12.52 per share.
SSE sold 525,000 common shares for aggregate proceeds of $6,751,500, or $12.86 per share, the company said.
Alcatel Telspace also purchased an additional 100,000 SSE common shares for $1,075,000, or $10.75 per share, from two members of the company's senior management, SSE Telecom said.
Alcatel Telspace now owns approximately 10 percent of SSE's outstanding common stock, the company said.
Also, Alcatel Telspace received a three-year warrant to purchase up to another 300,000 shares of SSE common stock at market price at the time of exercise but not less than $11 per share, SSE said.
The two companies also entered into an agreement to jointly develop certain satellite communications equipment, which will increase SSE's product offerings to its customer base, SSE said.
As part of the deal with Alcatel Telspace, the selling shareholders agreed to the early exercise of certain options and warrants, raising $233,000 for the company, SSE said.
The selling shareholders also have agreed not to dispose of any more shares before March 1997, SSE said.
In addition, the selling shareholders are parties to a stockholder agreement among Alcatel Telspace, SSE and certain shareholders.
SSE said 450,000 of the shares purchased by Alcatel were previously treasury shares that the company had repurchased and only 75,000 of the shares were newly issued.
